taste.name: Restraint: A Weight Ceiling of 500
taste.trigger: Needing a 64px hero headline to dominate the viewport
taste.decision: Set it at weight 400 — the same weight as body copy — rather than the 600-700 nearly every marketing site reaches for
taste.reason: At 64px the size alone already commands the page; adding weight past ~500 turns presence into aggression, and the restraint reads as confidence rather than salesmanship
evidence: no weight above 500 exists on the page (400x112, 500x42, 450x16)

taste.name: Depth Is Forbidden; Tone Does the Separating
taste.trigger: Distinguishing content panels from the page beneath them
taste.decision: Made the page floor #FAFAFA and panels #FFFFFF with shadows reduced to 1px hairlines, instead of lifting white panels off white with real elevation shadows
taste.reason: A 5-point tonal step is enough for the eye to read 'forward' without simulating physical layers; elevation implies things can be moved or dismissed, which is wrong for static marketing content
evidence: every shadow is 4 transparent layers plus one 8%-black or #EBEBEB ring
zero card components detected in viewport

taste.name: Optical Correction Only Where the Eye Catches It
taste.trigger: Setting type across a 64px to 11px range
taste.decision: Collapsed display line-height to exactly 1.0 and pulled tracking to -0.06em, while leaving body type at 1.43 and normal tracking, rather than applying one tracking rule across the whole scale
taste.reason: Letter-spacing and leading errors are invisible at 14px and glaring at 56px; correcting only the display tier is the smallest intervention that fixes what is actually perceptible
evidence: h1 64px/64px at -3.84px and h2 56px/56px at -3.36px, both exactly -0.06em

taste.name: Micro-Grid Inside, Vast Void Between
taste.trigger: Deciding rhythm for a page mixing dense UI clusters with distinct marketing sections
taste.decision: Ran component internals on a 2px grid and separated sections by 208px, deliberately leaving the middle of the spacing scale nearly empty
taste.reason: Tight internal spacing makes a cluster read as one object rather than loose parts, and only a gap far larger than any internal gap reliably signals 'new idea' — mid-range spacing would blur the two
